data.ideal_summary: We profiled translation at transcript isoform resolution by combining ribosome profiling or polysome fractionation with isoform-level quantification. Polysome-associated and total mRNA were sequenced using long-read (Nanopore or PacBio) or deep short-read RNA-seq to estimate isoform-specific ribosome loading. Translation efficiency was calculated per isoform and compared between isoforms of the same gene, revealing differences linked to 5' UTR, uORFs, and 3' UTR features.
method_notes: Standard Ribo-seq has short reads that often cannot be assigned to a single isoform; only reads over isoform-specific regions are informative.
Polysome profiling with long-read sequencing, or isoform-aware deconvolution, gives better isoform-level translation estimates.
Proteomics (PRIDE) rarely resolves isoforms except via isoform-specific peptides, so it is a weak fit.
